One Year After Red Fort Blast, India Intensifies Counterterrorism Efforts

One year after a car bombing at the Red Fort in Delhi, which killed 11 people, India has intensified its counterterrorism push. The blast exposed a terror network involving doctors, weapons suppliers, and overground workers. Families continue to mourn the victims and struggle to rebuild their lives.
